shortDescription: Official CBC marks entry, learner attendance & assessment portal for Reberwet JSS.
fullDescription:
Reberwet Junior Secondary School Portal is the dedicated administrative and pedagogical management application for teachers, senior teachers, and administrators at Reberwet JSS.

Key Capabilities:
• CBC Marks Entry: Rapidly record formative and summative assessment marks with automated percentage calculations, 4-level competency indicators (EE, ME, AE, BE), and grade distribution summaries.
• Daily Attendance Tracker: Streamlined morning and afternoon attendance taking with single-tap bulk marking and absence tracking.
• Learner Directory: Complete profiles for Grade 7, Grade 8, and Grade 9 students including admission numbers, parent contacts, assessment histories, and teacher comments.
• Instant PDF Report Cards: Generate MoE and KNEC compliant learner performance summaries with school crest, grading keys, and principal endorsements.
• Staff Communication & Gmail Desk: Integrated school communication for parent updates, staff memos, and departmental notices.
• Offline-First Reliability: Record marks in the classroom even without internet connectivity; all changes securely persist and synchronize automatically.

Designed specifically for educators in Kenya under the Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) framework.
